title: Satender Kumar Antil vs Central Bureau Of Investigation on 7 October, 2021
judges_list: Bench: Sanjay Kishan Kaul, M.M. Sundresh
conclusion_clean: order be circulated to the Registrars of the different High Courts to be further circulated to the trial Courts so that the unnecessary bail matters do not come up to this Court. This is the only purpose for which we have issued these guidelines, but they are not fettered on the powers of the Courts. Pending applications stand disposed of
